title.value: A Heat Diffusion Perspective on Geodesic Preserving Dimensionality Reduction
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: A Heat Diffusion Perspective on Geodesic Preserving Dimensionality Reduction

extractions.description: The paper introduces a novel dimensionality reduction method called Heat Geodesic Embedding, based on heat diffusion and Riemannian geometry, for preserving manifold geodesic distances in high-dimensional data. It establishes theoretical links between heat diffusion and manifold distances, and demonstrates the method's effectiveness in preserving ground truth manifold distances and cluster structure on toy and single-cell RNA-sequencing datasets.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper focuses on a method applicable to high-dimensional data analysis, including biological data, it doesn't explicitly focus on or heavily emphasize sustainable development themes. The core of the paper is on dimensionality reduction techniques.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Diffusion-based manifold learning methods have proven useful in representation learning and dimensionality reduction of modern high dimensional, high throughput, noisy datasets. Such datasets are especially present in fields like biology and physics.

primary_category.justification: The paper's primary focus is on a mathematical method for dimensionality reduction, not directly tied to any specific Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development category.
primary_category.quote: We define the heat-geodesic dissimilarity based on Varadhan’s formula and the two-sided heat kernel bounds. Based on this dissimilarity, we present a versatile geodesic-preserving method for dimensionality reduction which we call heat geodesic embedding.
